text:
anya: Quick check — small proposal for the Console forms: use a compact 'Req' badge + sr-only 'Required' for screen readers. Keeps labels short and is translation-friendly. sam: I like that. avoids wrapping. For errors on mobile, reserve a one-line slot under fields so the CTA doesn't get pushed under the keyboard. eli: Accessibility note: field errors should be role=status with aria-live=polite. form-level summary should be aria-live=assertive and focusable. fran: For destructive actions: security wants typed confirmation for deletes with side-effects. Proposal: typed-confirm for multi-item deletes or deletes flagged as high-impact; otherwise modal + undo toast. Allow paste but show a small "pasted" hint. anya: Animation wise, fade-in errors are fine but respect prefers-reduced-motion and ensure live region updates immediately (no animation delay). sam: Implementation snippet for label and slot:
eli: Decision? Req badge + sr-only token, reserved error slot, polite field live + assertive summary, typed-confirm only for high-impact deletes (no paste block, server normalize). fran: +1 sam: +1 anya: I'll draft a tiny prototype and PR with copy variants and notes for intl/security. tagging eng. design-bot: Created PR #4000 forms: compact-req + error-slot + typed-confirm (assigned to anya)
